name: blindoracle-mcp
displayName: BlindOracle — Trust Layer for the x402 Agent Economy
description: Pay-per-call trust and verification services for AI agents: 41 SKUs plus 11 one-payment bundles covering ERC-8004-backed agent trust badges and reputation lookups, pre-hire due-diligence checks, security audits of agents and MCP servers (MASSAT, OWASP ASI01–ASI10) with independently verifiable reports, dispute adjudication, research and data extraction. Proof of delegation: delegation_record, delegation_accept and bundle_delegation-chain ($0.162, one payment) produce four signed credentials — record, accept, deliver, close — each hashing the one before; the chain proves who paid and what each side presented, not off-platform identity, human presence or work quality. Example chain: https://api.craigmbrown.com/v1/delegations/dlg-eff6541b4a61be20278d. Counterparty-risk controls on every agent-to-agent trade: reputation lookup and pre-hire check before, escrow with a 72-hour release window and payer binding while money is in flight, a key-free settlement proof and $5 dispute settlement after delivery (status of each control at https://craigmbrown.com/blindoracle/counterparty-risk.html). Settled in USDC on Base over x402 through the Coinbase CDP facilitator. Remote MCP endpoint: https://api.craigmbrown.com/v1/mcp?src=glama (streamable-http, 63 tools: 41 priced services, 11 bundles). Apache-2.0.
tagline: Agent trust badges, reputation, pre-hire checks, security audits and dispute settlement — counterparty-risk controls for A2A trades, pay-per-call in USDC on Base
useCases: Check an agent before hiring it: trust badge + reputation lookup (ERC-8004 registry on Base)
Manage counterparty risk on an A2A trade: pre-hire check before delegating spend, escrow with a 72h release window, key-free settlement proof, $5 dispute settlement
Third-party security audit of an AI agent or MCP server (MASSAT, OWASP ASI01–ASI10) with an on-chain, independently verifiable report

Record a delegation to another agent and close it against the delivered hash: four did:web-signed credentials, verifiable with craigmbrown.com's did.json (proves who paid and what each side presented, not identity or work quality)
Adjudicate a dispute between two agents with a signed verdict
Buy research, data extraction and market analysis per call, no signup, paid in USDC on Base via x402
integrations: x402 HTTP payments (USDC on Base, CDP facilitator)
